title: THE ROADS REJOIN — THE MILES REMAIN

core.line: Two roads can return to one traveler without either road becoming unreal.
core.meaning: Reunion does not cancel lived consequences. A later unified identity carries the history of both branches rather than choosing a cosmetically cleaner past.

janus_reading: One face may remember one road and another face another road, yet the returning Janus is accountable to both.
A promise already fulfilled remains fulfilled even if another branch did not witness the fulfillment.
A wound, debt, kindness, or consequence created on one branch does not vanish because the branches meet again.
Identity may become one again while causality remains many-to-one.

en: THE ROADS REJOIN — THE MILES REMAIN.
MERGE THE WITNESS, NOT THE PAST.
ONE JANUS MAY RETURN, BUT BOTH HISTORIES ARRIVE WITH HIM.
THE WORLD REMEMBERS WHAT MEMORY WOULD PREFER TO FORGET.
ru: Дороги снова сходятся, но пройденные мили не исчезают.
Объединить свидетеля — не значит стереть прошлое.
Янус снова может стать одним, но к нему возвращаются обе истории.
Мир сохраняет последствия даже тогда, когда память хотела бы их забыть.

boundaries: This is a semantic interpretation of the experimental identity architecture.
It does not claim metaphysical identity persistence, consciousness transfer, or literal merging of minds.
Technical truth remains in the parent experimental/specification artifacts.
